expectation: Cytoplasmic stain in a minority of cells: dendritic cells, some macrophages (CD163+ subset) and activated endothelium, usually induced by IFN-gamma. Expect scattered or clustered bright cells in stroma and immune-rich tumour regions, varying between images, with most tumour and stroma cells negative.
observed: A: discrete bright cells, dense in a few images (immune-rich stroma) and sparse in others. B and C: almost empty. D: an elongated bright cytoplasmic cell. E: large, cleanly bounded bright cells beside and partly on CD163+ cells; the background is dark.
why: Discrete, cell-shaped cytoplasmic positives sit in clusters whose density varies between images, among CD163 macrophages, with a clean background. That is a specific population, not haze or debris.
notes: Ido1 marks distinct bright cells clustered in immune-rich regions of several images and is absent from typical fields. In the CD163-dense field the Ido1 cells sit among the macrophages and partly overlap them, as expected for Ido1+ myeloid cells.
